snippet.title: Super Smash REX [TAS] - Master Chief Classic Mode (Intense, No Damage)
snippet.description:
So Smash REX dropped two days ago and as soon as I found out, I knew EXACTLY which run I was doing first.

Also, crazy how Master Chief is the first REX character I do a run for, all while XBOX is going to hell right now.

Could've done much better on BTT specifically, but I think this one came out alright. It's been ages since I've touched anything involving Project M and anything related to it.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
0:00 Intro
0:11 Vs. DK & Jigglypuff
0:48 Vs. Sonic
1:12 Vs. Giant Banjo/Kazooie
1:41 Vs. Pyra
2:03 Break The Targets 1 (This one sucked tbh)
2:40 Vs. Ken & Sub-Zero
3:08 Team Knuckles
3:46 Vs. Waluigi
4:08 Vs. Giant Yu
4:40 Vs. Metal Blood Falcon
5:01 Vs. Team Captain Falcon
5:23 Break The Targets 2
5:56 Vs. Alucard, Geno, & Yoshi
6:44 Vs. Master & Crazy Hand
9:00 Ending
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
